name: Locaweb Cloud and VPS

evidence.vps: 03: Locaweb Cloud rents isolated VMs and the VPS is a prepaid server the customer manages

line: Rent Linux virtual servers or cloud VMs and manage their software.

free.text: No free plan; new customers may get up to R$100 off first invoice

cells.regions: 2 Brazil Cloud zones; VPS in Brazil; no cities listed

work.math: R$20 for the VM + R$30 for NAT + R$5 for an IP address = R$55 a month before tax. 100 GB of transfer is listed as free. The 100 build minutes are run by you. The domain is extra.
R$40 for the VM + R$30 for NAT + R$5 for an IP address = R$75 a month before tax, for 730 hours. 1 vCPU and 2 GB, but transfer overage terms and request performance are unclear.

work.plan: 2 Cloud Small VMs + NAT + public IP
work.math: R$115 a month before tax, as a subtotal (2 × R$40 + R$30 + R$5). 10 GB of private traffic and seven daily snapshot copies are not priced.
